name: The Barn RV Park
note: Privately owned no-frills RV park at 1752 Haynesville Hwy, El Dorado. 26 back-in sites with full hookups (30/50 amp), big-rig access, bathhouse, laundry, WiFi; large shaded lots. Family-run, currently operating. RV Life 4*/$$ (auto 6/2026; RV Life detail page shows a more modest 7.3/10 review score). --Claude Renamed The Barn RV Park (formerly Barnyard RV Park), 2026. --Claude

name: Centerpoint Horsecamp & Lodge
note: FLAGGED: privately owned multi-use trailhead facility at 8175 AR-43, Compton, near the Centerpoint Trailhead and Buffalo National River. Offers drive-in RV sites alongside cabins, B&B rooms, hostel bunks, tent camping, plus horse stalls, dump station, and shower house. Equestrian-leaning (named a horsecamp) but takes RVs; RV site count/length/hookups not confirmed online - verify before relying on it for a 23-ft rig. --Claude

name: T.P. Miller RV Park
note: Privately owned (owner-operated) RV park near Hamburg on/near US-82; full-hookup sites (30/50 amp), takes one-night and longer stays. Reviews note some monthly/working-guest use but it accepts transients. PIN APPROXIMATE (RV Life geo, ~10 km SW of town center) - verify before relying. --Claude

name: Swinging Bridge Resort
note: Family-owned RV park on the Little Red River at the Swinging Bridge near Heber Springs; trout-fishing oriented. Full-hookup sites (water/electric/50 amp/sewer/cable). Takes nightly transients (2-night min weekends) in addition to annual/monthly sites. PIN APPROXIMATE (RV Life geo) - verify. --Claude

name: Lake Leatherwood City Park
note: Eureka Springs Parks & Recreation city park on 1,610 acres around Lake Leatherwood (1303 CR 204). 4 RV sites (water/electric/septic) plus 4 electric campsites; max RV length 30 ft; also primitive/tent sites and cabins. Reservable online via FareHarbor. RV Life 1*/$$ (auto 6/2026; lightly reviewed public park). --Claude

name: Berryville RV Park
note: City of Berryville-owned RV park (~506 S Main St / US-62) along a creek inside city limits; info center shared with the Chamber. ~30 pull-thru full-hookup sites, 30/50A, FCFS; RVs/5th wheels only, no tents; $165/week, pay by drop box. Parks office at Berryville Community Center. RV Life rating not recorded (auto 6/2026). --Claude

name: Craighead Forest Park (Jonesboro)
note: City of Jonesboro park on Crowley's Ridge along ~50-acre Craighead Lake, at 3009 Dan Avenue. ~36-41 RV sites with water + 30/50A electric, table/patio/fire ring/grill, bathhouse with showers, laundry; FCFS (host collects payment on arrival); $15 senior, $15 extended-stay Nov-Feb. Longest reported rig ~40 ft. RV Life rating not recorded (auto 6/2026). --Claude

name: Ann Lake Campground (Sand Dunes State Forest)
note: Ann Lake Campground in the 225-acre Bob Dunn Recreation Area, Sand Dunes State Forest near Zimmerman; 36 individual rustic drive-in sites (no hookups), vault toilets, water spigots. Loop road is rough/sandy — plan a smaller rig. Individual sites first-come, first-served; 4 group camps reservable. Ann Lake beach is a short drive/hike from camp. --Claude

name: Banning State Park
note: Banning State Park drive-in campground on the wooded plateau above the Kettle River gorge near Sandstone; 33 sites, 11 electric, modern restrooms/showers, dump station. Reservable online (some FCFS). Separate canoe-in sites on the river. --Claude

name: Cascade River State Park
note: Cascade River State Park campground on the Lake Superior North Shore along Hwy 61 near Lutsen; 40 sites (20 electric, 4 pull-through), RVs to ~35 ft, modern restrooms/showers, dump station; reservable plus some FCFS. --Claude

name: Bear Lake Campground - George Washington State Forest
note: Rustic DNR state-forest campground and day-use area on Bear Lake; 29 primitive drive-in sites (cleared pad, fire ring, table), vault toilets, drinking water. No hookups. First-come, first-served, pay on site. Managed by Scenic State Park. --Claude

name: Birch Lake Campground - Birch Lakes State Forest
note: Rustic DNR state-forest campground on Big Birch Lake; 24 shaded drive-in sites plus 5 walk-in sites and a reservable group camp, vault toilets, hand-pump drinking water, boat landing. No hookups or showers. Individual sites first-come, first-served; group camp reservable by phone. --Claude

name: Cottonwood Lake Campground - Bowstring State Forest
note: Remote rustic DNR state-forest campground on Cottonwood Lake, reached by gravel forest roads NE of Deer River; 10 primitive drive-in sites (cleared pad, fire ring, table), latrine toilets, drinking-water spigot, boat landing. No hookups. First-come, first-served via fee-envelope kiosk. Managed by Schoolcraft State Park. --Claude

name: Button Box Lake Campground - George Washington State Forest
note: Rustic DNR state-forest campground on Button Box Lake; 13 primitive drive-in sites (cleared pad, fire ring, table), vault toilets, drinking water. No hookups. First-come, first-served, pay on site. Managed by Scenic State Park. --Claude

name: Devilfish Lake Campground - Grand Portage State Forest
note: Rustic DNR state-forest campground on Devilfish Lake in the Arrowhead north of Grand Marais; 5 primitive drive-in sites (cleared pad, fire ring, table) with a dock and lake access, vault toilet. No hookups, no reservations (first-come, first-served). No gas motors on the lake. --Claude

name: Esther Lake Campground - Grand Portage State Forest
note: Small rustic DNR state-forest campground on Esther Lake north of Grand Marais; 3 primitive drive-in sites (cleared pad, fire ring, table), ADA vault toilet, boat ramp and dock. No hookups, no trash service, first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Finland Campground - Finland State Forest
note: Rustic DNR state-forest campground at the confluence of the Baptism River's east and west branches in the village of Finland, ~7 mi from Lake Superior/Tettegouche; 39 primitive drive-in sites (cleared pad, fire ring, table), vault toilets, drinking water; 15 sites have ATV trail access. No hookups; best for smaller self-contained units. First-come, first-served for a fee; group site reservable through Tettegouche State Park. --Claude

name: Hungryman Lake Campground - Two Inlets State Forest
note: Rustic DNR state-forest campground on the south shore of Hungry Man Lake, ~10 mi south of Itasca SP; 14 primitive drive-in sites (cleared pad, fire ring, table), vault toilets, drinking water, boat access. No hookups. First-come, first-served, fee on site. Managed by Itasca State Park. --Claude

name: Huntersville Forest Landing Campground - Huntersville State Forest
note: Rustic DNR state-forest campground on the Crow Wing River, a popular paddling put-in/take-out near Nimrod and Menahga; 24 drive-in sites (one ADA), 5 vault toilets, drinking water, river access for swimming/fishing/boating. No hookups. First-come, first-served, fee on site. Managed by Itasca State Park. (Distinct from the separate Shell City Horse Camp in this forest.) --Claude

name: Larson Lake Campground - George Washington State Forest
note: Rustic DNR state-forest campground on Larson Lake (a designated trout lake) SE of Effie; 12 primitive sites (cleared pad, fire ring, table) with drive-in plus some hike-in/walk-in sites, vault toilets, drinking water. No hookups. First-come, first-served, pay on site. Managed by Scenic State Park. --Claude

name: Shell City Horse Camp - Huntersville State Forest
note: Shell City Horse Camp on the Shell River, Huntersville State Forest (managed by Itasca SP): 27 equestrian sites plus 8 general drive-in individual sites open to everyone (FCFS); rustic, gravel-road access ~4 mi off paved Rte 18, vault toilets, drinking water, no hookups. On 24 mi of horse trail. --Claude

name: Sullivan Lake Campground - Finland State Forest
note: 11 primitive lakeside sites on Sullivan Lake, Finland State Forest, off paved Hwy 6 ~25 mi N of Two Harbors; suited to tents and small RVs (~25 ft), vault toilets, drinking water, boat launch; no hookups. First-come, first-served (self-register). --Claude

name: Clint Converse Campground (Washburn Lake) - Land O'Lakes State Forest
note: Clint Converse Campground on Washburn Lake, Land O'Lakes State Forest: 31 primitive sites, RVs up to 26 ft, vault toilets, drinking water, dock, boat access, swimming; no hookups. First-come, first-served; phone reservations also accepted (DNR forest line). --Claude

name: Willow River Campground - General C.C. Andrews State Forest
note: 38 sites (36 drive-in, 2 ADA, 1 group) along Zalesky Lake, General C.C. Andrews State Forest, just off I-35 at Willow River; spacious wooded back-in sites suit tents and RVs, vault toilets, drinking water, paved boat ramp; no hookups. First-come, first-served and reservable online/by phone. --Claude

name: Birch Lake Campground & Backcountry Sites
note: Superior NF (Kawishiwi district) campground ~13 mi SE of Ely on Birch Lake; ~32 sites in two loops (incl. 2 cabins), most accommodate RVs/trailers, vault toilets, hand-pump water, boat ramp. Reservable via Recreation.gov (some FCFS). The named backcountry sites are separate. --Claude

name: Cadotte Lake Campground
note: Superior NF (Laurentian district) campground on the W shore of Cadotte Lake near Brimson; 27 wooded sites in two loops, some fit RVs up to 45 ft, vault toilets, boat ramp, sandy swim beach. Mix of Recreation.gov-reservable and FCFS sites. --Claude

name: Chippewa Loop Campground
note: Chippewa NF, Norway Beach Rec Area near Cass Lake; the Chippewa loop has 46 sites, ~30 with electric hookups (the only electric loop in Norway Beach), flush toilets, showers, drinking water. Mix of Recreation.gov-reservable and FCFS sites. No dump station in the rec area. --Claude

name: Clubhouse Lake Campground
note: Chippewa NF (Deer River district) campground on Clubhouse Lake near Marcell, ~8 mi E of Marcell off MN-38 (last mile gravel, all-vehicle passable); ~47 sites (28 reservable + 19 FCFS), sites handle rigs up to 45 ft though about half suit smaller rigs/tents, vault toilets, hand-pump water, swim beach, fishing pier. Reservable via Recreation.gov. --Claude

name: Crescent Lake Campground & Backcountry Sites
note: Superior NF (Tofte district) campground on a peninsula in Crescent Lake, ~24 mi NNE of Tofte via the Sawbill Trail + FR 170; 32 sites (~20 reservable, 13 FCFS) plus 1 group site, vault toilets, boat access; many sites have water views/access. Reservable via Recreation.gov. The drive-in loop is separate from the backcountry sites. --Claude

name: Deer Lake Campground
note: Chippewa NF (Deer River district) campground on the W shore of Cut Foot Sioux Lake (adjacent to Lake Winnibigoshish), ~20 mi NW of Deer River; two loops - North (17 sites) and South (31 sites), 48 total - flanking a central boat ramp, all non-electric, vault toilets. Mix of Recreation.gov-reservable and FCFS sites. --Claude

name: Devil Track Lake Campground
note: Superior NF (Gunflint district) campground on the N shore of Devil Track Lake near Grand Marais; 16 pull-in sites, vault toilets, boat ramp. Most sites fit a moderate vehicle, some are not RV-suitable. First-come, first-served, self-pay; winter camping free FCFS. --Claude

name: Divide Lake Campground & Backcountry Sites
note: Superior NF (Tofte district) small campground on Divide Lake, E of Isabella on FR 172 (on the Laurentian Divide); 3 pull-in sites with level pads, solar drinking-water faucet, vault toilet, walk-down canoe launch. Sites fit a moderate vehicle, not designed for RVs. First-come first-served self-pay. The drive-in sites are separate from the carry-in backcountry site. --Claude

name: East Seelye Bay Campground
note: Chippewa NF (Deer River District), 13 first-come, first-served sites on Seelye Bay of Cut Foot Sioux Lake/Lake Winnibigoshish ~20 mi N of Deer River; vault toilets, boat ramp, swim beach; non-electric, rustic (sites tight for big rigs per reviews). --Claude

name: Echo Lake Campground & Backcountry Sites
note: Superior NF (LaCroix District), 22 sites (13 reservable incl. 1 group, 9 FCFS) on 1,222-acre Echo Lake off the Echo Trail ~22 mi NE of Orr; non-electric, vault toilets, solar water, boat ramp + sandy beach; pull-in sites accept RVs/trailers (to ~45 ft per listing). 2 boat-access backcountry sites are separate. --Claude

name: Iron Lake Campground
note: Superior NF (Gunflint District), 7 sites on Iron Lake ~38 mi up the Gunflint Trail from Grand Marais; non-electric, vault toilets, drinking water, boat ramp; site 1 FCFS, rest reservable; RVs/trailers 20-40 ft (some sites tight). --Claude

name: Lake Jeanette Campground
note: Superior NF (LaCroix District), single-loop CCC-era campground on a peninsula on 638-acre Lake Jeanette off the Echo Trail ~32 mi NE of Orr; 12 sites total (6 reservable + 4 FCFS drive-in + 2 walk-in tent), non-electric, solar drinking water, boat access; pull-in sites for moderate-size vehicles; open ~May to late Sep. Note: RV Life mistags this as boat-in 'Backcountry Sites' - it is a drive-in campground. --Claude

name: Little Isabella River Campground
note: Small secluded Superior NF campground in red/white pine on the Little Isabella River, 4.5 mi W of Isabella; 11 sites (6 FCFS, 5 reservable), back-in, no hookups, vault toilet; most sites fit small RVs to ~24 ft (marginal for a 23-ft rig). --Claude

name: Mabel Lake Campground
note: Secluded Chippewa NF campground on Mabel Lake with a sandy beach and boat ramp, ~6 mi W of Remer; 22 sites (10 reservable, 10 FCFS, 1 host), no hookups, vault toilets, no potable water (bring your own). --Claude

name: McDougal Lake Campground
note: Superior NF campground on 323-acre McDougal Lake, 10 mi W of Isabella; 21 sites (13 FCFS, 8 reservable) - drive-in sites for RVs/trailers plus hike-in tent sites; most accommodate RVs to ~24 ft, no hookups, solar-pump water, vault toilets, sandy swim beach + boat ramp. --Claude

name: Mosomo Point Campground
note: Chippewa NF campground on a quiet cove between Little and Big Cut Foot Sioux Lakes (adjoining Lake Winnibigoshish), ~19 mi N of Deer River; 23 wooded sites in red/white pine, no hookups, vault toilets, boat access; reservable (FCFS if not booked 4+ days out). --Claude
